Furzedown Primary School Open Days 2026
Will your child be starting Nursery or Reception in September 2027?
Come along to one of our open sessions to discover life at Furzedown, meet members of our team and learn more about what makes our school such a special place.
Sessions will take place on a selection of mornings and afternoons. Please complete the registration form below and select your preferred date from the available options.
Please come prepared for the weather, as part of the tour will take place outdoors.
We look forward to welcoming you to Furzedown!
